A Journey of Curiosity and Discovery

I am a Professor of Computer Science with a passion for artificial intelligence, machine learning, and their real-world applications. My work explores how intelligent systems can solve meaningful problems and create positive impact in society.

Over the past 18+ years, I have enjoyed teaching, conducting research, and collaborating with students, researchers, and industry partners around the world.
